name: RocketReach
notes: RocketReach files people by email. One request per saved email address. If a profile exists, RocketReach sends a link to that address, and the opt-out only finishes after the link is opened and the next page is completed. If that inbox is connected to OpenOptOut, the link is clicked for you.
source: Steps per Redact's RocketReach removal guide; fallback privacy@rocketreach.co.
